clue.text: Don't eat quickly

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to go without food, as a verb
second meaning: at speed, as an adverb

explanation.walkthrough: Read together it looks like advice against bolting food; the two parts are separate senses of one word.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for abstaining from food and an adverb for moving at speed.

clue.text: Complete issue to be raised when game is over

parts.note: full means complete

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means lifted upward, so the word is read bottom to top

parts.note: to emit is to issue, give out

explanation.surface: A complete issue will be raised once the match ends.
explanation.definitionFit: The final whistle marks the end of a football match, the moment called by this phrase.

clue.text: Condemn feeling that's heartless

indicators.note: heartless says the central letter of the word is removed

parts.note: sentience is the capacity for feeling

explanation.surface: A judge condemns an emotion that lacks compassion.
explanation.walkthrough: SENTIENCE has nine letters, so its heart is the fifth, I.
explanation.definitionFit: A judge who passes punishment on a convicted person is said to condemn them to it.

clue.text: Her co-stars playing in big bands

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters of the fodder performing in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A performer's fellow stars appear with large swing ensembles.
explanation.definitionFit: Large groups of musicians playing together, such as symphony ensembles, are fairly called big bands.

clue.text: Out of practice, dependable opener's dismissed

indicators.note: in cricket an opener bats first; here the first letter of the word is sent off

parts.note: trusty means dependable

explanation.surface: A reliable opening batsman, unpractised, is out.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is cricket: an opener is a batsman who goes in first, and 'dismissed' means out.
explanation.definitionFit: Skills that have not been used for a while deteriorate, like metal left exposed to corrode.

clue.text: Pantomime character's spotted dog

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the masked figure in diamond-patterned costume from the harlequinade
second meaning: a Great Dane with a patchy black-and-white coat

explanation.walkthrough: It reads as a character's pet; the two parts are separate senses. Pantomime is a traditional British Christmas stage show.
explanation.definitionFit: The patchwork-costumed clown of pantomime shares a name with a Great Dane colour pattern of torn patches.

clue.text: Rep's odd sprees inside parlour

indicators.note: inside says the reworked letters go within the parlour

parts.note: a salon is a parlour, as in a beauty parlour

indicators.note: odd suggests something strange, so the letters are put in an unusual order

explanation.surface: A representative goes on strange shopping binges in a beauty parlour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rep' could be a repetition at the gym; here it is short for a sales representative.
explanation.definitionFit: A rep is short for representative, someone who sells goods for a company.

clue.text: Splendid English feast

parts.note: regal means splendid, fit for royalty

explanation.surface: A magnificent English banquet.
explanation.definitionFit: To regale guests is to entertain them lavishly with food and drink, a verb sense of feast.

clue.text: Get out of prison early in the year

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to free them from jail
second meaning: the season after winter

explanation.walkthrough: Read together it sounds like early release from jail in January; the parts are separate senses.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a slang verb for engineering a jailbreak and also the season that comes early in the calendar.

clue.text: Feline of course, heard

indicators.note: heard tells us the answer is spelt as something sounds when spoken

parts.note: links is a golf course, especially one by the sea

explanation.surface: Of course a cat could be heard, the clue seems to say.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Of course' looks like a casual aside; here 'course' means a golf course, the links.
explanation.definitionFit: The animal is a wild cat with tufted ears, so it belongs to the feline family.

clue.text: Go back inside realtor's abroad, expert on houses?

indicators.note: inside says one piece is placed within the other
abroad suggests letters scattered far and wide, so the word is rearranged

parts.note: the letters of realtor's, without the apostrophe, are the fodder

indicators.note: back says the word go is read in reverse

explanation.surface: An estate agent's office overseas, with someone told to retreat into it, featuring an expert on property.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Houses' suggests the property market of the realtor; in fact it means the twelve divisions of the zodiac chart. Realtor is the American word for an estate agent.
explanation.definitionFit: A horoscope divides the sky into twelve houses, which a stargazing fortune-teller interprets.

clue.text: Criminal charge concealed by people in authority responsible for treatment

indicators.note: concealed by says the charge is hidden inside the people

parts.note: they is used for the unnamed powers that be, as in 'they say'
a rap is an informal word for a criminal charge, as in 'beat the rap'

explanation.surface: Officials are hiding a criminal accusation against someone in charge of medical care.
explanation.definitionFit: A course of remedial care for an illness or a mental condition is a form of medical treatment.

clue.text: Foremost of authors completes extremely praiseworthy novel

indicators.note: foremost of means the leading letter of authors

parts.note: perfects means completes, finishes

indicators.note: extremely means the two extreme letters, first and last

explanation.surface: The leading writer finishes a book that is highly commendable.
explanation.definitionFit: It is John le Carré's 1986 spy book, so the title names a work of fiction.

clue.text: Greek character working after piles damaged

indicators.note: after places working at the end, following the reworked letters
damaged says the letters of piles are broken up and reassembled

parts.note: on means working, as a machine is on

explanation.surface: A Greek person keeps working despite suffering from piles.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the fifth letter of the Greek alphabet, and a character can mean a written letter.

clue.text: Comic strip character of little importance

definitions.meaning: first meaning: Disney's cartoon mouse, who also starred in comic strips
second meaning: trivial or amateurish, as an adjective

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase reads like a minor role in a cartoon; it is two meanings of the same name.
explanation.definitionFit: Disney's famous rodent's name is also used informally for anything trivial, shoddy or second-rate.

clue.text: Hawthorn, say, is not certain to blossom

parts.note: may expresses possibility, so 'it may' means it is not certain to
to flower is to blossom

explanation.surface: A hawthorn bush might not bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: The hawthorn is called may, and its white blossom is an example of that tree's flowers.

clue.text: Number holding one aboard tug at sea, one on the run?

indicators.note: holding says the number contains the rest

parts.note: five is a number

indicators.note: aboard says one is placed inside, as on a boat
at sea means confused, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A runaway is a number of people with one on a tugboat out at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'one' is wordplay; the second belongs to the definition, a person on the run.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone escaping from the police or prison is a person running away from the law.

clue.text: Supporter of that woman through a depression

indicators.note: through says the woman passes into the middle of the hollow

parts.note: a dent is a hollow or depression
her refers to that woman

explanation.surface: A fan of a woman who is going through depression.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower or backer of a cause or party is a supporter of it.

clue.text: Met team's brief by small courtyard

parts.note: flying means brief, as in a flying visit
S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
a quad is a quadrangle, an enclosed courtyard

explanation.surface: A police team's briefing takes place beside a little yard.
explanation.walkthrough: The Met is London's Metropolitan Police. 'Brief' looks like a noun for a briefing or a lawyer; here it is an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: The rapid-response robbery unit of London's Metropolitan Police is a well-known squad of detectives.

clue.text: Put right about couple

parts.note: re means about, concerning
a pair is a couple

explanation.surface: Fixing a broken item concerning two people.
explanation.definitionFit: To fix something broken or faulty is to mend it, putting it right.

clue.text: In Munich, an elegant fashion house

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: An elegant couture firm in the German city of Munich.
explanation.definitionFit: The Paris couture label founded by Coco is a famous designer brand.

clue.text: Decent chalet I built

indicators.note: built suggests the letters are assembled into a new structure

explanation.surface: A respectable chalet that the speaker constructed.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone morally upright and principled can be described as decent.

clue.text: What could be alight on sixth of November!

definitions.text: What could be alight on sixth of November!

indicators.note: on places alight next to the letter, attached on to it

parts.note: the sixth letter of November
alight means on fire, burning

explanation.surface: What might still be burning the day after Guy Fawkes Night?
explanation.walkthrough: Guy Fawkes or Bonfire Night, 5 November, is when Britain lights fires and fireworks; the embers could still glow on the 6th, while the sixth letter of November gives B.
explanation.definitionFit: A large outdoor fire is lit on Guy Fawkes Night, and its embers could plausibly still be burning the following day.

clue.text: Bishop is enclosing doubly large invoices

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

indicators.note: enclosing says the outer letters wrap around the large ones

parts.note: doubly asks for the abbreviation for large a second time
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A bishop is wrapping up two hefty invoices.
explanation.definitionFit: Requests for payment for goods or services are statements of charges owed.

clue.text: Writer from county town recalled breaking record

indicators.note: breaking says the town splits the record and sits inside it

parts.note: an annal is a record of a year's events

indicators.note: recalled, read as called back, says the town is written backwards

parts.note: Lewes is the county town of East Sussex

explanation.surface: An author from a provincial town recalled having broken a record.
explanation.walkthrough: A county town is the administrative centre of an English county; LEWES serves East Sussex. Reversed it gives SEWEL, which breaks into ANNAL.
explanation.definitionFit: She was the English novelist who wrote Black Beauty, so she is a writer.

clue.text: Starts to jump in very energetic dance

indicators.note: starts to means the opening letters of each following word are taken

explanation.surface: Instructions to leap very energetically as a dance begins.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a lively swing style danced to jazz and rock and roll music.

clue.text: Very angry missing start of exciting sporting event

indicators.note: missing says a letter is lacking from the phrase

parts.note: really means very, as in really good

indicators.note: start of means the first letter of exciting

parts.note: cross means angry

explanation.surface: Someone is furious at missing the start of a thrilling sports fixture.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a motor race held on a mixed circuit of tarmac and dirt, a competitive motorsport.

clue.text: Enthusiasm shown by some in maze — students

indicators.note: some in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some students lost in a maze show great keenness.
explanation.definitionFit: Keen relish or gusto for something is zeal, a near synonym of enthusiasm.
